scripts.contact: node render/export.mjs --only=0,40,63,105 && ffmpeg -v error -y -pattern_type glob -i 'out/contact/*.png' -vf scale=540:540,tile=2x2 out/contact.png
scripts.mux: ffmpeg -v error -y -framerate 30 -i out/frames/%05d.png -i out/audio.wav -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 24 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/sample.mp4
